# [CS034] Session Cookie Without Secure (cookie-missing-secure)

A session cookie may be sent over plain HTTP.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-614](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/614.html) |
| **OWASP** | A07:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Without Secure, the browser also sends the cookie over http:// requests, where anyone on the network can read it.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: id, HttpOnly: true})
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: "session", Value: id, HttpOnly: true, Secure: true})
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [cookie-missing-secure]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    cookie-missing-secure: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore cookie-missing-secure -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** cookie-missing-secure
```
